title: #223 Women's Care
prompt: A study shows that women may need more care than men. To what extent do you agree with it?

promptSegments.text: A study shows that women may need more care than men.
To what extent do you agree with it?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Women need more support in their lives because they face different needs than men.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Women need more support in their lives because they face different needs than men.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Women have many responsibilities, such as looking after family members, which requires extra care.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Women have many responsibilities, such as looking after family members, which requires extra care.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that care and support are necessary for all people, regardless of gender, refuting the idea that women need more care than men.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that care and support are necessary for all people, regardless of gender, refuting the idea that women need more care than men.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides two main points: both genders require support for family life, and both genders must prioritize their own health and care.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides two main points: both genders require support for family life, and both genders must prioritize their own health and care.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the physical and medical needs of women, using reproductive health as an example.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the physical and medical needs of women, using reproductive health as an example.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the emotional and social roles of women, using the role of the mother as an example.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the emotional and social roles of women, using the role of the mother as an example.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that women do not need more care than men, focusing on the idea that societal expectations and domestic roles place unique burdens on women.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that women do not need more care than men, focusing on the idea that societal expectations and domestic roles place unique burdens on women.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay supports its disagreement by discussing the emotional pressures women face and the extra caregiving responsibilities they often manage.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay supports its disagreement by discussing the emotional pressures women face and the extra caregiving responsibilities they often manage.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the extent to which women may need more care than men, considering biological, sociocultural, and structural factors.
outline: Body 1: Sociocultural Norms and Gender Roles
keyArguments: Sociocultural norms assign women to caregiving roles, increasing their need for care.
Biological differences and societal expectations contribute to women's vulnerability and care needs.
